timing.order: flows -> fund flows toward target -> rebalancing decision -> trades + costs -> earn month-t returns

definitions.real: real values deflate by realised CPI into dollars of 2026-09-30
definitions.forward: bootstrap of joint real returns of the eligible sleeves (and CPI) over the information set at the last historical month; policies recompute targets on every path every month; dollars of the last historical month
